answer: A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The echo counter is kept in quill and forge publishes each reset. A hostile operator hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1545 identities would post 2944 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
